notes.title: V. 1.01 PATCH: Lights Out
notes.notes:
A quick update for THE AWKWARD STEVE DUOLOGY went up today!!

- Tweaked pathing so you can't turn the lights off more than once in "A Stranger Comes Calling". (Thanks to whoever pointed that out at SAAM Arcade!)
- Fixed save-menu bug. (There shouldn't be one. It's a short game.)
- Did not add a new Achievement (but I thought about it).

Enjoy!!

notes.title: Interview with Paul Franzen about Awkward Steve, the Smithsonian, and being awkward
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Paul (the funny-looking bearded guy in Awkward Steve) (also the developer) recently did an interview with The GameCola Podcast, about his experiences showing off the game at the Smithsonian and life as an awkward indie dev in general. Check it out if you're interested!

https://gamecola.net/2017/11/gc-podcast-114-awkward-steve-at-the-smithsonian-paul-franzen-interview/

notes.title: Awkward Steve Duology coming to the Smithsonian!
notes.notes:
I'm beyond excited to announce that THE AWKWARD STEVE DUOLOGY is going to be exhibited at the Smithsonian American Art Museum in August, as part of the SAAM Arcade! It's happening Aug. 5th and 6th, for anyone who wants to hang out with us in D.C. and play lots of weird indie games!!

http://americanart.si.edu/calendar/saam-arcade/
